concerns.analysis: On page 4, the output flattens the list hierarchy. The source PDF lists sub-items (f through j) under a parent section, followed by distinct parent-level numbered items (6. Executive Committee Report, 7. Education Committee Report). The output merges these into a single ordered list where the sub-items (f through j) and the parent-level items (6 and 7) are sibling elements, stripping the numbering from 6 and 7 in the process. This fundamentally breaks the list structure and meaning.
concerns.source_pdf_quote:
f) Cybersecurity Remediation Initiatives... 
6. Executive Committee Report – Mr. Shipp...
concerns.output_quote: A single list array with items containing 'f) Cybersecurity Remediation Initiatives...' and 'Executive Committee Report – Mr. Shipp...' at the same sibling level.
